summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of AgroLink.ml bilingual corporate website. Backend API testing: 31/31 tests passed (100%). Frontend testing: Language switching (PT default), all public pages, contact form with validation and submission, admin authentication, dashboard, enquiries management, and navigation all working correctly. Minor issue with admin product creation form field filling in automated test (form validation working as expected).
